checks.evidence: NEI Magazine (2026-10-28), citing Antares after DOE NSDA approval: initial field deployments to US military installations begin in 2028, including a Fort Bragg Janus plant. The Janus contract requires the R1 units to be built, factory-delivered and fully operational by 30 September 2028. POWER (2026-08-27) reports the Army selected Antares for three R1 units at Fort Bragg, with initial production units to military installations beginning in 2028.
